model.offense: 45% PPA vs expectation + 20% success rate vs expectation + 15% explosiveness vs expectation + 10% points/drive vs expectation + 10% scoring vs expectation; game deviation adjusted by opponent defensive strength
model.defense: mirror of opponent offensive performance vs expectation, adjusted by opponent offensive strength
model.expectation: pregame blend of the team's prior production and opponent's prior allowance, with same-week FBS baseline fallback
model.opponent_adjustment: asymmetric 0.80x–1.20x adjustment: strong opponents amplify positive outperformance and soften underperformance; weak opponents do the reverse
model.recency: 5% additional weight per successive game, capped at 1.15x
model.overall: 50% Offensive Strength + 50% Defensive Strength, re-percentiled across FBS
model.ap_rank: reference only; never enters the formula
